grid.cell: column i, row j covers town x in [i, i+1) and y in [j, j+1); row 0 is the northern edge

elevation.encoding: 16-bit grayscale PNG; sample = elevation in centimetres above NAVD88 (GEOID12B)

source.encoding: 8-bit grayscale PNG; 0 = mean of the ground returns in the cell, 1 = filled (push-pull interpolation under buildings, trees and gaps), 2 = water (Lake Dora at the lidar water level)
